messages:
Maya (Product): Quick sync — need to finalize scope for the predictive prefetch pilot. Customer requires burst capacity + HSM-backed keys. Who owns sequencing and what are realistic timelines?
Jin (Eng): We can do burst but runtime needs async batching + KV cache tuning. Priya/Alex/Sam — rough lift?
Priya (Runtime): Async batching + KV cache toggles is ~2 sprints (2 engs). Need a test harness for sequence distributions. Also need pinable model variants for graceful fallback.
Alex (Infra): Dedicated burst pool is doable but requires capacity pin + autoscale policy and VPC routing changes. I estimate infra work ~10 dev-days (including testing). Need expected RPS and burst window.
Sam (Security): HSM/KMS review: we need network design + threat model. If customer insists on on-prem HSM, add compliance gap analysis. I can start the security review next Wed.
Maya (Product): Proposed launch criteria: 1) Customer acceptance test passed; 2) p50 <150ms for 512 tokens on dedicated pool; 3) automatic fallback to hosted-compatible model variant; 4) security signoff (HSM or equivalent). Anything missing?
Jin (Eng): Add: perf regression suite gated in CI, and a chaos test that validates fallback during capacity loss. Also we should document quantization vs quality tradeoffs.
Priya (Runtime): Agree. Runtime will implement fallback policy and canary routing. We need a config flag to pin model versions per-tenant. Also request a small canary capacity slice for staged rollout.
Alex (Infra): I'll reserve infra slot and draft autoscale config. Action: need expected sustained RPS and burst QPS numbers. Please send by EOD.
Sam (Security): If HSM timeline slips, fallback plan: customer-managed KMS + full audit logging and runtime key rotation. I'll outline checklist and required approvals.
Nora (PMM): Noting customer expectations — they want an SLA mention in comms. For pilot, label as "pilot SLO" unless sales commits to capacity.
Maya (Product): Action items recap: Jin -> perf test PR by Tue; Alex -> reserve infra slot and add autoscale runbook by EOD; Sam -> draft HSM design & checklist; Priya -> runtime fallback/canary plan; Nora -> customer comms draft. I'll update roadmap and ping stakeholders. :thumbsup:
Jin (Eng): Perf test command for quick repro: `./run_perf --model prefetch-v1 --tokens 512 --concurrency 8 --duration 60s`
deploy-bot: Scheduled infra slot created: ticket INFRA-7421 (reserved window 2024-09-15..2024-09-29)
Maya (Product): Thanks all — will post an updated deck in #product-docs once action items are in.
Priya (Runtime): Small note: runtime tests need at least one quantized and one FP16 variant to compare latency/quality. I'll add to the test matrix.
Alex (Infra): Sending RPS ask shortly. If anyone needs access to the reserved pool for early testing, DM me.
Sam (Security): Blocking item: external auditor availability for HSM review — I'll surface options in the doc.
Maya (Product): OK — follow-ups in thread. If nothing urgent, we'll reconvene next Tue 11am.
